newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.30 lower.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.30 lower.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.30 cent per lb weaker on Thursday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, dealers said.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture will delay its weekly export and sales report until Friday, due to the holiday earlier this week.
Wednesday, the July contract finished 0.24 cent higher at 73.21 cents per lb, having ranged from 73.25 to 72.75 cents. New-crop December closed 0.19 cent higher at 75.32 cents.
